title: Should You Use Graphics On Your Resume? [Recruiter Tips]
description:
Is your resume filled with graphics and pictures? Not getting responses from your applications?

It may be your resume. In a market where you want to stand out as much as possible, utilizing graphics and images can potentially hurt your candidacy and impact your getting interviews.

Why? Our recruiter, Leah Dillon, shares her insights on why graphics may hurt rather than help.

Whether it's rating yourself less than or filling the valuable real estate with images over qualifications, you want to be presenting yourself as the most qualified version.
